run_imagenet_evaluation: run ImageNet-1K evaluation on a vision transformer model using the CLI with a dataset path
run_distributed_evaluation: run distributed ImageNet evaluation across multiple GPUs using the multiprocessing-distributed flag
review_validate_function: review the validate function that evaluates a model on a validation dataloader and reports accuracy metrics
review_AverageMeter_class: review the AverageMeter class that computes and stores running average and current values for metrics
test_accuracy_function: test the accuracy function that computes top-k accuracy over model predictions and ground truth labels
